name: Balamath
summary: Balamath is an Ayleid ruin in eastern Craglorn, north of Elinhir, containing Blackcaster conjurers and atronachs. It also contains beetles and centipedes in numbers.
notes: Prior to Update 12, this location was an instanced 4-player Group Delve.
There is an optional boss, the Corrupted Scion of Balamath, that can be summoned by activating three switches on a pillar inside the ruins, north from the entrance.
Balamath Hall, located in the western section of the delve, can only be accessed during Elemental Army. The Air Monarch within Balamath Hall, Parel Nirus, is not required for delve completion.
